How we work

Two teams.
One rider record.

The field team supports the person at the hub. The office connects that work to the pay cycle.

  1. 01
    In the field

    Recruiters and fleet staff

    Recruiters coordinate onboarding and company assignments. Fleet staff record rental handovers, maintenance and returns.

  2. 02
    In the office

    Payout operations

    The office matches company earnings to the right rider, checks deductions and reviews the bank’s transfer results.
